reference_sql:
SELECT store_code, order_month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY store_code, order_month
ORDER BY store_code, order_month
alternatives: SELECT store_code, order_month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-03-31' GROUP BY store_code, order_month ORDER BY store_code ASC, order_month ASC
SELECT store_code, order_month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM sales WHERE order_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-01' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT store_code, order_month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31' GROUP BY order_month, store_code ORDER BY store_code, order_month
